name: agent-deck
description: Side pane showing every subagent of the session: status, model, type, task title, prompt summary, elapsed time and what it is doing.

autoOpen.title: Open on first subagent
autoOpen.description: Open the agent deck by itself when the first subagent spawns, only where it docks as a sidebar (fullscreen layout, wide terminal).

statusLine.title: Status line
statusLine.description: Show a status line (e.g. '⚙ 2 agents running') while subagents run.
